actions.title: Draft use case UC-1: Divide one number by another
actions.body:
Refs #2

Drafts UC-1 for the request to divide one number by another. It adds one row to the table and one block before the Template section. The status is draft and the class is proposed; the owner decides both.

This is a feature request with no accepted use case behind it. I drafted UC-1, "A user divides one number by another", in a use-case pull request for your review. It also covers the zero divisor, which the issue does not mention; accept or change that when you review it.
